interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to ensure visibility and safety during evening hours, as no luminaires are visible.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while also contributing to traffic calming through vertical enclosure.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and signage to clearly designate pedestrian priority areas.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from the roadway.
